content_sections.heading: Indian Army Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The recruitment is intended for outstanding sportspersons who meet the eligibility requirements prescribed by the Army Sports Control Board. Applicants must possess qualifying sporting achievements in the disciplines and competitions recognized for the current recruitment intake. Sporting achievement certificates and supporting documents must be submitted along with the prescribed application form. The uploaded short notice does not provide a complete list of eligible sports, competitions, participation levels or achievement dates. Candidates should check the detailed Intake 07/2026 Sports Quota Instructions on the official Indian Army recruitment website. The short notification invites applications from unmarried candidates. Applicants must satisfy the marital-status conditions prescribed in the detailed recruitment instructions. The uploaded short notice does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should verify the Matriculation or other academic eligibility requirements for Havildar and Naib Subedar Sports Quota Intake 07/2026 before submitting their forms.

content_sections.text: The Indian Army conducts Sports Quota recruitment to select outstanding sportspersons based on the applicable sporting achievement and recruitment standards. The recruitment process may include application scrutiny, shortlisting based on sports credentials, sports trials, physical fitness assessment, medical examination and document verification, as prescribed for the current intake.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Apply Offline
content_sections.text: Candidates must download the prescribed application form and submit it with their supporting sports and educational documents to the Army Sports Control Board. Application Form Website: joinindianarmy.nic.in Submission Mode: India Post only. Application Start Date: 1 December 2026. Application Last Date: 31 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM. The official notice does not provide an online submission facility for the completed recruitment application. Candidates must follow the postal application procedure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indian Army Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Indian Army recruitment website at joinindianarmy.nic.in . Find the notification for Direct Entry Havildar and Naib Subedar (Sports), Intake Serial No. 07/2026. Download the detailed recruitment instructions and prescribed application form. Read the complete eligibility conditions, sports qualifications, age requirements and submission instructions. Check whether your sporting achievements meet the prescribed criteria. Print the official application form in the required format. Fill in the personal, educational and sports achievement details accurately. Enter your contact information and other particulars required in the form. Attach the required educational qualification certificates. Attach the prescribed sports participation and achievement certificates. Include any additional documents and photographs specified in the detailed instructions. Check that the application form is complete and signed in the required places. Prepare the postal envelope in accordance with the official instructions. Address the application to the Directorate of PT & Sports, Army Sports Control Board, New Delhi. Send the application through India Post using the permitted postal service specified in the detailed instructions. Ensure that it reaches the prescribed office between 1 December and 31 December 2026, not later than 5:00 PM on the closing date. Keep a copy of the application and postal tracking details for future reference. Important: The Army Sports Control Board has explicitly instructed candidates to submit applications through India Post only. Late applications will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Postal Address
content_sections.text: Completed applications must be sent to the address published in the official recruitment notice. Directorate of PT & Sports / ASCB, Dte Gen of Integrated Training, General Staff Branch, IHQ of MoD (Army), Room No. 402, 4th Floor, East-Wing Zone 1, Shaurya Bhawan, Thal Sena Bhawan, PO Delhi Cantt. - 110010, New Delhi, India. Candidates should reproduce the postal address exactly as specified in the official detailed recruitment instructions and use any mandatory envelope superscription.

content_sections.text: The short notification specifically directs candidates to submit their application form together with sports and educational documents. Prescribed application form. Educational qualification certificates and marksheets. Sports achievement certificates. Sports participation certificates. Proof of date of birth. Valid identity proof. Recent passport-size photographs, if prescribed. Other category or eligibility certificates, where applicable. Additional documents required under Intake 07/2026 instructions. Applicants should follow the current detailed instructions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Army for outstanding sportsperson candidates under the sports quota intake for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Havildar and Naib Subedar under the Sports Quota as per advertisement number SER NO : 07/2026.

faq.question: Q3. When does the application submission start?
faq.answer: The application submission process starts on 1 December 2026 for eligible unmarried male and female sportsperson candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 31 December 2026. Applications received after this date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must send their application form through Indian post only to the specified office address.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Unmarried male and female sportsperson candidates who possess the required outstanding sports achievements and educational qualifications are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form along with sports and education documents must be sent to the Directorate of PT & Sports/ASCB, Room No - 402, Shaurya Bhawan, Delhi Cantt.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Indian Army Havildar and Naib Subedar sports quota recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach necessary sports documents and educational certificates along with the duly filled offline application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Indian Army website at https://joinindianarmy.nic.in to download the official notification and application form.
